info.title: InnPilot API
info.description: Hotel operations and finance API. All amounts are decimal strings. Tenant and property scope always come from the session, never from request data.

session.name: __Host-ip_session
session.description: Session cookie set by POST /auth/login. State-changing requests must also send the `x-csrf-token` header with the value of the `__Host-ip_csrf` cookie.
